source: openFDA drug label API (FDA Structured Product Labeling)
method: Thresholds hand-written from each label; every quote verified word-for-word against the label section at build time.

rules.title: Metformin contraindicated: eGFR below 30
rules.action: Do not use. Stop metformin and switch to an alternative antidiabetic.
rules.quote: contraindicated in patients with: Severe renal impairment (eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73 m2)

rules.title: Metformin: eGFR 30–45 needs a benefit–risk review
rules.action: Do not start metformin at this eGFR; if already taking it, reassess benefit and risk.
rules.quote: whose eGFR later falls below 45 mL/min/1.73 m 2 , assess the benefit risk of continuing therapy.

rules.title: Lithium not recommended: CrCl below 30
rules.action: Avoid lithium; refer to the prescriber for an alternative mood stabiliser.
rules.quote: Lithium is not recommended for use in patients with severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance less than 30 mL/min evaluated by Cockcroft-Gault)

rules.title: Lithium: reduced kidney function (CrCl 30–89)
rules.action: Use a lower dose, titrate slowly and monitor serum lithium levels frequently.
rules.quote: Start patients with mild to moderately impaired renal function (creatinine clearance 30 to 89 mL/min evaluated by Cockcroft-Gault) with dosages less than those for patients with normal renal function

rules.title: Ciprofloxacin: dose adjustment for CrCl 50 or below
rules.action: Adjust per the label table: CrCl 30–50 → 250–500 mg every 12 h; 5–29 → every 18 h.
rules.quote: Creatinine Clearance (mL/min) Dose > 50 See Usual Dosage. 30–50 250–500 mg every12 hours 5–29 250–500 mg every 18 hours

rules.title: Levofloxacin: dose adjustment for CrCl below 50
rules.action: Adjust the dosing regimen per the label's renal table to avoid accumulation.
rules.quote: In patients with renal impairment (creatinine clearance less than 50 mL/min), adjustment of the dosage regimen is necessary to avoid the accumulation of levofloxacin

rules.title: Fluconazole: halve the dose for CrCl 50 or below
rules.action: After the loading dose, give 50% of the usual daily dose (non-dialysis).

rules.title: Naproxen not recommended: CrCl below 30
rules.action: Avoid naproxen; consider acetaminophen and ask the prescriber.
rules.quote: Naproxen-containing products are not recommended for use in patients with moderate to severe and severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance <30 mL/min).

rules.title: Allopurinol: lower starting dose for eGFR 60 or below
rules.action: Start low per the label table (e.g. eGFR >30–60 → 50 mg daily) and titrate.
rules.quote: Recommended Initial Dosage in Adult Patients with Gout eGFR Initial Dosage > 60 mL/minute No dosage modification > 30 to 60 mL/minute 50 mg daily > 15 to 30 mL/minute 50 mg every other day

rules.title: Methotrexate: reduced elimination (CrCl below 90)
rules.action: Higher toxicity risk; confirm dose with the prescriber and monitor blood counts and kidney function.
rules.quote: Methotrexate elimination is reduced in patients with renal impairment [creatinine clearance (CLcr) less than 90 mL/min, calculated using Cockcroft-Gault]

rules.title: Sildenafil: start at 25 mg (CrCl below 30)
rules.action: Consider a 25 mg starting dose; exposure roughly doubles in severe renal impairment.
rules.quote: patients with severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance <30 mL/minute)

rules.title: Sildenafil: start at 25 mg (age over 65)
rules.action: Consider a 25 mg starting dose in patients over 65.
rules.quote: Consider a starting dose of 25 mg in patients > 65 years
